question: Compute Pearson correlation of original numeric x and y, no binning. Recipe pearson_r with verification_missing complete_case and verification_bins 0. Use scipy.stats.pearsonr; report its statistic and pvalue. Return a single summary row with n, x_mean and y_mean. The host will compute the Fisher-z 95% interval. Describe uncertainty; do not claim causality.
